application_commit: One DynamoDB TransactWriteItems call atomically writes the identity ledger, version-checked state, materialized output, and any outbox row. ClientRequestToken is derived from generation_id and event_id.
archive: Before application commit, write canonical raw bytes to S3 key raw/schema=1.0.0/date=<UTC-date>/event_id=<id>/<payload_digest>.json with If-None-Match *. On 412, verify stored digest; on 409, retry with bounded backoff.

boundaries.retry: record is re-read; archive and transaction run

boundaries.boundary: after raw archive, before DynamoDB transaction
boundaries.retry: conditional archive detects identical object; transaction runs once
idempotency token and conditions make the retry safe
identity and version conditions classify retry as already applied

possible_durable_effects: failed record may have raw object only
boundaries.retry: Lambda resumes from the lowest reported failed sequence; committed events are idempotent
boundaries.safety: checkpoint does not pass the earliest failed record

boundaries.boundary: poison event after quarantine transaction, before response
boundaries.retry: quarantine key and outbox_id are stable; event returns success after durable isolation
boundaries.safety: poison record cannot block the shard indefinitely

boundaries.boundary: after SQS outbox send, before delivered marker
boundaries.retry: notification can repeat; downstream deduplicates by outbox_id

boundaries.boundary: record exceeds retry or age bound
boundaries.retry: Lambda writes full discarded invocation to failure S3 destination
boundaries.safety: run fails until failure object is adjudicated; no success claim while unresolved

checkpoint_owner: AWS Lambda event source mapping; a batch is acknowledged only after the handler returns success or reports a bounded partial failure

claims.application_effect: idempotent only after this protocol is implemented and AWS-tested
claims.raw_completeness: unverified until source/archive count and digest reconciliation passes
claims.recovery: unverified until injected AWS crash runs pass

lambda_mapping.on_failure_destination: dedicated S3 failure prefix retaining the full invocation record

quarantine: DynamoDB quarantine/outbox is the durable authority. SQS is an at-least-once notification/redrive channel; consumers deduplicate by outbox_id.
runtime: AWS Lambda consuming Kinesis through an event source mapping
